# Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview

**stock-analysis-v1** is a PHP project for performing fundamental analysis on U.S. stocks. It is built around a stock screener that identifies bullish trends and all-time high (ATH) conditions, adding analysis tools to support investment research for U.S. equities.

## Language & Stack

- **Language:** PHP
- No framework, build system, or test runner has been set up yet.

## Project Goals

- Fundamental stock analysis for U.S. market data
- Bullish trend detection and ATH identification
- Combining technical screening with fundamental evaluation
